body.heading: Print a row
paragraphs: Press your fingertip into the ink or paint and stamp it on the paper. Try a row of prints in a line.
That row is already a caterpillar waiting to happen.

body.heading: Add the details
paragraphs: Draw tiny legs, wings, eyes, and antennae on your prints. One print can be a bee; three can be a train.
Look closely at your fingerprint's swirls. Even your art has a pattern only you can make.

takeaway: No two fingerprints are the same, and each one can become a creature.
safetyNotes: Wash hands well after printing; an adult checks the ink or paint is washable.
screenFreeExtension: Make a fingerprint picture of your whole family as tiny creatures.
